headline: Rising Dividend and Buybacks Might Change The Case For Investing In McKesson (MCK)
summary: Earlier this week, McKesson Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of US$0.94 per share, payable on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the September 1, 2026 ex-dividend and record date. This higher payout highlights how McKesson is combining dividend growth with its existing share repurchase efforts, reinforcing management’s confidence in the company’s earnings power. headline: McKesson (MCK) Stock May Still Be A Bargain After A 324% Run
summary: McKesson stock has logged a very strong 323.9% return over the past five years, yet the latest valuation checks still flag it as screening on the cheap side. This raises the question of how much of the story is already reflected in the current US$840.90 share price. Over five years, McKesson has returned 323.9%, which puts long term holders in a strong position and makes today’s entry point more sensitive to the valuation starting point.
